tips.Number of VOs: How many Village Organisations belong to this CLF.
tips.Number of SHGs: How many Self-Help Groups belong to this CLF, across all its VOs.
tips.Total Members: How many individual SHG members belong to this CLF.
tips.Active Members: How many of this CLF's members are currently marked active on LokOS, out of the total.
tips.Formation Date: The date this CLF was formed.
tips.Registration Date: The date this CLF was formally registered as a cooperative society.
tips.CLF Status: Whether this CLF is both Model and Registered, Model only, Registered only, or neither, based on the audit form.
tips.Platform Approval Status: Whether this CLF's registration on LokOS has been approved, is pending, or was rejected by the Block Manager.
tips.Co-option Status: Whether this CLF is newly formed, was co-opted from an earlier structure, or was revived after being inactive.
tips.Registration Code: This CLF's official state cooperative society registration number.
tips.Executive Committee Size: How many members sit on this CLF's Executive Committee.
tips.President: The name of this CLF's current President.
tips.Secretary: The name of this CLF's current Secretary.
tips.Subcommittee Membership: How many members sit on each of the CLF's six functional subcommittees.
tips.Meeting Frequency: How often this CLF's Executive Committee is supposed to meet.
tips.Savings Schedule: How often this CLF collects savings from its member VOs.
tips.Member Composition: The share of this CLF's members who belong to Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes.
tips.Education & Literacy: The share of this CLF's members who can read and write.
tips.Members With a Livelihood: The share of this CLF's members who reported at least one livelihood activity (farm or non-farm) on their LokOS profile.
tips.Members With Multiple Livelihoods: The share of members who reported more than one livelihood activity.
tips.Livelihood Split: What kinds of livelihood activities this CLF's members are engaged in, combining their primary, secondary, and tertiary activities.
tips.Special Project Activities: Which optional CLF-run initiatives — like a Custom Hiring Centre, Didi Ki Rasoi, or livestock activities — this CLF has taken up, as reported in its audit.
tips.Cadre Roles in This CLF: Which specialised community-cadre roles (like Master Book Keeper, Enterprise Promotion, or Krishi Mitra) are staffed in this CLF, and how many members hold each.
tips.Audit Grade: This CLF's official letter grade from its most recent (Q4) audit.
tips.Total Audit Score: This CLF's total audit score out of 100, from its most recent (Q4) audit.
tips.Standing vs. Peers: How this CLF's total audit score compares to every other CLF in its district.
tips.Accounting: How well this CLF keeps its accounting books, cash/bank records, loan verification, MIS quality, and fixed-asset records — out of 19, and how that compares to peers.
tips.Receipts & Payments: How well this CLF manages and records its receipts and payments — out of 20, and how that compares to peers.
tips.Loan: How well this CLF reviews loan demand and manages loan repayment — out of 18, and how that compares to peers.
tips.Group Performance: How well this CLF's SHGs, VOs, and the CLF itself are functioning — out of 23, and how that compares to peers.
tips.Cadre Management: How well this CLF manages its cadre members — out of 10, and how that compares to peers.
tips.Operational Self-Sufficiency: How much of this CLF's running costs are covered by its own earned income — out of 10, and how that compares to peers.
tips.Detailed Scores: The individual line items that make up each audit category score, so you can see exactly where points were gained or lost.
tips.Irregularity Flag: Whether this CLF's Q4 audit flagged a financial irregularity.
tips.Type of Irregularity: Which category of issue the auditor's remark falls under - a flagged CLF can match more than one.
tips.Cash Book vs. Physical Cash: The difference between what the CLF's cash book says it should have on hand, and what was physically counted during the audit.
tips.Books Balance Check: Whether this CLF's reported Total Assets match its reported Total Liabilities & Equity.
tips.Liquidity Ratio: The share of this CLF's assets sitting as cash or bank balance, rather than out on loan or invested.
tips.Fund Deployment Ratio: The share of this CLF's financial assets that are actually out on loan to SHGs, VOs, or other CLFs, rather than sitting idle.
tips.Where the Fund Came From: How this CLF's total capital breaks down between government grants, its own members' contributions, and money borrowed from banks or other institutions.
tips.Surplus / Deficit: This CLF's reported surplus or deficit, shown as a share of its total assets — a negative number means a deficit.
tips.Net Cash Flow: The difference between what this CLF received and what it paid out this quarter.
tips.Where Money Came In From: What this quarter's receipts were made up of — savings deposits, interest earned, loan repayments, and other income.
tips.Where Money Went Out To: What this quarter's payments were made up of — loans and advances to member CBOs, running costs, and other expenses.
tips.Operating Expense Ratio: How much this CLF spent on its own running costs, as a share of everything it received this quarter.
tips.Interest Income Share: How much of this CLF's receipts came from interest earned by lending to members, rather than from deposits or other income.
tips.% of Loans Disbursed: Of everything ever requested by this CLF's member SHGs/VOs, how much has actually been disbursed to date.
tips.Loan Amount Still Pending: How much loan money has been requested by member SHGs/VOs but not yet disbursed.
tips.This Quarter's Disbursement Rate: Of the new loan demand raised this specific quarter, how much was actually disbursed.
tips.Capacity to Meet Demand: Whether this CLF currently has enough cash and bank balance on hand to cover this quarter's still-pending loan demand.
tips.Loan Amount Demanded This Quarter: How much loan money this CLF's member SHGs/VOs newly requested this specific quarter.
tips.This Quarter's Pending Loans: Of this quarter's new loan demand, how much hasn't been disbursed yet.
tips.Share of VOs Requesting Loans: The share of this CLF's member VOs/SHGs that actively requested a loan this quarter.
tips.Receipts Over Time: How this CLF's quarterly receipts have moved over the last five quarters.
tips.Payments Over Time: How this CLF's quarterly payments have moved over the last five quarters.
tips.Cash Balance Over Time: How this CLF's quarterly closing cash balance has moved over the last five quarters.
tips.Loans Disbursed Over Time: How this CLF's total loans disbursed has grown over the last five quarters.
tips.Disbursement Rate Over Time: How this CLF's disbursement rate has moved over the last five quarters.
tips.Balance Sheet: This CLF's full balance sheet, exactly as reported.
tips.Receipts & Payments Statement: This CLF's full receipts and payments statement for the selected quarter, exactly as reported.
tips.FSF-Eligible VOs: How many of this CLF's VOs qualify for the Food Security Fund — at least 40% of their members belong to SC/ST groups.
tips.VOs With Incomplete Coverage: How many VOs haven't yet received their full ₹1,50,000 VRF government grant.
tips.Idle VOs: Of the VOs that have received VRF funds, how many earned no interest from lending last year.
tips.Total VRF Received: The total VRF government grant this CLF's VOs have received to date.
tips.Total Savings Collected: The total member savings collected across this CLF's VOs.
tips.Total Interest Collected: The total interest earned by this CLF's VOs from lending VRF funds to members.
tips.Total Fund Size: The combined size of this CLF's VRF fund — grant, savings, and interest together.
tips.Coverage Gap: The total grant amount still owed to VOs that haven't received their full ₹1,50,000.
tips.Savings as Promised: How much of the savings members were supposed to contribute has actually been collected.
tips.What the Fund Is Made Of: How this CLF's VRF fund breaks down between the original government grant, member savings, and interest earned.
tips.Grant Not Fully Received: How many VOs are still owed part of their VRF grant.
tips.Fund Sitting Idle: How many VOs that have received VRF funds earned no interest from lending them out last year.
tips.VO Identity: Which VO this row is about, and who its bookkeeper is.
tips.VO Fund Status: Whether this VO is FSF-eligible, has received its full grant, and is currently lending out its VRF funds.
tips.SHG Members: How many SHG members belong to this VO.
tips.VO Fund Metrics: How well this VO is doing on savings discipline, interest earned, and overall fund growth.
tips.VO Savings Discipline %: How much of the promised monthly savings has actually been collected, out of what should have been saved by now.
tips.VO Interest Yield: How much of the total fund came from interest earned by lending to members, rather than from savings or the grant.
tips.VO Corpus Multiplier: How many times bigger the total fund has grown compared to the government grant it started with.
tips.Bookkeeper Identity: Which bookkeeper this row is about, how many VOs and members they cover, and their overall rank within this CLF.
tips.Bookkeeper Fund Metrics: How this bookkeeper's VOs are doing on savings, fund growth, and coverage, combined into one composite score.
tips.Fund Projections: Where this CLF's savings, interest, and total fund size are headed by 31 March 2027, under three different assumptions about lending activity.
tips.Social Development Fund: How much this CLF should be collecting from its VOs each month, and each year, for the Social Development Fund.
tips.Month-by-Month Projection: A month-by-month look at how this CLF's savings, interest, and total fund are projected to grow.
tips.Total Entitlement Demands: How many entitlement/scheme demands this CLF's members raised in the selected year.
tips.Schemes Accessed: How many of those demands have actually been fulfilled.
tips.Schemes Still Pending: How many of those demands are still awaiting fulfilment.
tips.Demand & Access by Scheme: Which government schemes this CLF's members are demanding most, and how many of each have actually come through — shown as 'pending' rather than 0% for a year too recent to have been processed yet.
tips.Total PGSRD Requests: How many public-goods, resource, or service requests this CLF's members raised in the selected year.
tips.Type of Request: Whether requests are for public goods, resources, or services.
tips.Most-Requested Items: The specific items requested most often, and the total quantity demanded for each.
tips.By Development Theme: Which broader development themes these requests fall under.
tips.By GPDP Focus Area: Which Gram Panchayat Development Plan focus areas these requests relate to.
tips.Total Social Issues Raised: How many social development issues this CLF's members raised in the selected year.
tips.By Sector: Which broad sector these issues fall under.
tips.Most-Raised Issues: The specific social issues raised most often, how many times each was raised, and roughly how many people each one affects.
tips.Government Departments Involved: Which government departments are most often implicated by these issues.
tips.Fund Deployment: This CLF's fund deployment ratio, converted to a percentile against other CLFs.
tips.Bookkeeping Accuracy: How closely this CLF's Assets match its Liabilities+Equity, converted to a percentile — a closer match ranks higher.
tips.VRF Fund Health: This CLF's VRF fund-management metrics, each converted to a percentile against other CLFs.
tips.Subcommittee Completeness: How many of this CLF's six subcommittees are actually staffed, converted to a percentile.
tips.Active Membership: The share of this CLF's members currently marked active, converted to a percentile.
tips.Cadre Diversity: How many different specialised cadre roles this CLF has staffed, converted to a percentile.
tips.Insurance Coverage: The share of this CLF's members with insurance, converted to a percentile.
tips.Aadhaar KYC Coverage: The share of this CLF's members with Aadhaar KYC verified, converted to a percentile.
tips.Livelihoods Diversification: The share of this CLF's members with more than one livelihood activity, converted to a percentile.
tips.Overall Score: This CLF's overall performance score, combining fund management, financial health, governance, and inclusion into one number, and how it compares to other CLFs in its district and across Bihar.
